tabs.tab_content: Our training is delivered live online via Zoom. Each session is interactive with hands-on exercises, group discussions and real-world case studies. You'll also get access to recorded sessions and course materials.

tabs.tab_title: What if I miss a live session?
tabs.tab_content: All live sessions are recorded and shared with you within 24 hours. You can catch up at your own pace and reach out to your trainer if you have questions.
Yes. Upon successful completion of the course, you'll receive a certificate of completion that you can add to your CV and LinkedIn profile.
No prior experience is needed. Our courses are designed for beginners and career changers. We start from the fundamentals and build up to industry-level skills.

tabs.tab_title: What's included in the course fee?
tabs.tab_content: The course fee includes live training sessions, course materials, project feedback, career support, interview preparation, and lifetime access to our alumni community.
Simply choose your course and click 'Explore Course' to learn more. You can also request a call back and we'll help you choose the right option for your goals.
